title: Not worth price yikes!
text: Very disappointed for the price. It came with 3 50 cent face masks ,1 50 cent hand mask, 2 cheap dog treats, 1 dollar store dog toy and 1 dollar dog chew, a dollar store picture frame, and a collar charm that is also dollar store quality. In total I think the value was $16 at most. I bought other boxes that at least had a retail close to the cost. Don’t disappoint yourself, stay clear of this subscription box that takes aim at dog moms and aims to empty your pockets! Bad pup mom company!
label: negative
